yui.title: Almost Coffee
yui.text: Yui finds you on the back steps at dusk with two cups of something that is almost, but not quite, coffee. It smells of burnt barley, and they both pull the same face at the first sip. They talk about home for hours: trains, convenience stores, the vending machine on the 4th floor that only ever ate her coins. She pushes her glasses up, twice, and then she cries a little. So do you.

choices.label: Sit with her until the cups go cold
choices.res: They stay there until the cups are cold and the lanterns are lit, shoulders touching, saying the names of train stations like prayers. She files the evening under "keep."

choices.label: Pass her a napkin and a joke
choices.res: You offer a napkin and a terrible vending machine joke. {N} laughs wetly, pushes up her glasses, and leans just a little against the step rail closer to you.

image.comp: sitting on back steps with him holding two steaming cups, laughing about home
image.setting: back steps of an inn at night, lanterns, stars

yui.title: Bath Time Budget Meeting
yui.text: Hunting for the ledger, Yui walks straight into the washroom while you are in the tub, a cloud of steam rolling past her glasses until they fog completely. She does not leave. She stares fixedly at the ceiling. Then the floor. Then the ceiling again, clutching the account book to her chest like a shield, her ears the color of boiled shrimp.

choices.label: "Could you pass me a towel?"
choices.res: She throws it directly at your face and flees, the account book forgotten on the stool. You find a neat sticky note inside: "Variance: 1 towel."

choices.label: Act completely casual
choices.res: She stammers through the entire weekly budget review, right there, without once looking down, glasses fogged, voice cracking on "depreciation." It's honestly impressive. You approve every line item.

choices.label: Yell
choices.res: She flees, mortified, glasses clattering on the tiles, and avoids you for three days, sliding reports under your door instead of speaking.

image.comp: standing in a washroom doorway clutching a ledger, staring fixedly at the ceiling, bright red
image.setting: steamy wooden washroom, a man in the tub off-frame

yui.title: Instant Ramen, Reconstructed
yui.text: Yui reveals she's been "recreating" instant ramen in the kitchen for a month. The broth is a pale, apologetic grey, and the noodles have the texture of wet rope. It is terrible. They eat all of it anyway, passing one chipped bowl back and forth. "Remember when you covered my shift that time?" she asks, eyes on the steam. "I liked you before the truck, you know."

choices.label: Tell her you liked her too, then finish the bowl
choices.res: You tell her, a little clumsily, and she covers her face with the cup. They scrape the bowl clean. She says it's the best ramen she's ever made, and for once she is not lying about it.

choices.label: Declare it a triumph of accounting
choices.res: "Best ramen in the realm," you say, which is technically true. {N} laughs, tucks her hair behind her ear, and doesn't take back what she said.

image.comp: eating a terrible bowl of homemade ramen with him at a kitchen table, both laughing
image.setting: small inn kitchen at night, pots and steam

yui.title: The Way Home
yui.text: A traveling mage claims he can send otherworlders home. Yui shows you the flyer with shaking hands, the ink smeared where she's held it too long. It smells of cheap incense. She stands in the doorway of the office and won't come inside. "If it's real... would you go?"

choices.label: "I'd stay. This is home now."
choices.res: She lets out a breath she's been holding for a week, shoulders dropping an inch, and straightens the flyer into a neat square before putting it away.

choices.label: "I don't know."
choices.res: Honest. It still hurts. She nods, pushes her glasses up, and files the flyer in a drawer. She doesn't bring it up again.

choices.label: "Only if you came with me."
choices.res: She laughs and wipes her eyes under her glasses. (The mage turns out to be a fraud. Neither of them is disappointed.)

image.comp: holding a crumpled flyer with shaking hands, looking up at him with teary eyes

yui.title: Festival Night
yui.text: Yui drags you to the harvest festival, all lantern strings and fried dough, and wins you a prize at the ring toss: a deeply ugly stuffed wyvern with mismatched button eyes. She insists you carry it all night. People stare. She enjoys that more than she'll admit, her cheeks pink with cider and delight.

choices.label: Wear it like a hat, proudly
choices.res: She laughs so hard she has to sit down on a barrel, glasses crooked. For the rest of the night, strangers toast the hat.

choices.label: Win her one back
choices.res: It takes eleven tries, a lot of coins and a vendor's pity. She keeps the slightly-less-ugly griffin on her desk forever, between the stapler and the abacus.

image.comp: at a harvest festival handing him an ugly stuffed wyvern prize, triumphant grin
image.setting: harvest festival at night, game stalls, paper lanterns

yui.title: Second Chance
yui.text: Yui takes your hand under the table during the staff meeting and doesn't let go, her thumb tracing the inside of your wrist while she reads out the quarterly figures in a perfectly level voice. Afterward, in the empty office, the lamp low, ledgers stacked behind her: "Second life. Second chance. I'm not wasting this one being shy." She kisses you, glasses bumping your nose, and pulls you toward her room.

choices.label: Not yet
choices.res: {N} nods and squeezes your hand once. "I can wait. Don't make it too long." She pushes up her glasses and goes back to her columns, smiling.
